name: oac-sb-domains-tools
description: Build tooling for OAC_SB_Domains. Source lives under tools/ and is bundled into xdomains/scripts/ so the distributed xdomains tree is self-contained.

scripts.//: Generated-path registry: any new generated path must also be registered in .gitattributes (see the xdomains/scripts and .opencode/context entries).
scripts.//build:check: The bundles under xdomains/scripts/** and the generated docs under .opencode/context/** are marked -diff in .gitattributes, so `git diff` will not show their contents; inspect the source (or use `git diff --no-index`) instead.
scripts.build: bun run build:shared && bun run build:scan && bun run build:gather && bun run build:sense && bun run build:version-drift && bun run build:act && bun run build:verify && bun run build:run && bun run build:compose && bun run build:studio-config && bun run build:registry && bun run build:docs
scripts.build:check: bun run build && git diff --exit-code -- xdomains/scripts .opencode
